t.E966.agn: In the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E966.body: When consumed in excess, it may cause gas and diarrhoea in the gut.
t.E966.eff.0.t: May cause gas, bloating and diarrhoea (laxative effect); in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols
t.E966.eval: Polyol (sugar alcohol): in the EU, the warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols; avoided in sensitive gut (FODMAP) diets.
t.E966.prod: Obtained by catalytic hydrogenation of lactose (a chemical process).
t.E966.regx.0: The warning “excessive consumption may produce laxative effects” is mandatory on products containing more than 10% added polyols (1169/2011 Annex III).
t.E966.summary: A polyol produced from milk sugar (lactose). Used in sugar-free confectionery and chocolate.
t.E966.what: A sugar alcohol (polyol): it provides sweetness and bulk in sugar-free products and retains moisture.
